Receding hairline with thin, light-colored hair swept backward and prominent brow ridges on an oblong facial shape with angular bone structure. The face features a high forehead with deep temples, thin light-colored soft-arched eyebrows with lateral thinning, and deep-set eyes with a downward slant and visible upper-lid creases. A wide mouth with thin lips and visible upper teeth is present, along with a straight nasal dorsum and rounded tip. The individual has high cheekbones with moderate projection, deep nasolabial folds, and a smooth jawline with a rounded chin, with ears featuring attached lobes positioned alongside the central face line.
